"""Main-owned CPU review of the source-only capture receipt companion."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('capture_adapter_review_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
names = ['tools/fixed_history_capture_receipt.py', 'tools/test_fixed_history_capture_receipt.py',
         'docs/FIXED_HISTORY_CAPTURE_RECEIPT.ja.md', 'docs/FIXED_HISTORY_CAPTURE_RECEIPT.md']

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    parent = json.loads((B / 'main-phase-cache-admission-publication-root-v1/record.json').read_text())
    assert parent['passed'] and parent['complete'] and not parent['active']
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in parent['commands'])
    out = B / 'main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    env = json.loads((B / 'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5/record.json').read_text())['environment']
    env = dict(env, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=env, source_pins={name: m.sha(W / name) for name in names},
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_capture_qualified=False,
             persistent_state_qualified=False, quality_qualified=False, adopted=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv):
        print('OWNED CPU ADAPTER CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=180, cpu=1200, rss_cap=2 << 30,
                            text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=16 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text() + '\n' + se.read_text()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip() == '010909772b621c71f1c635b4e1ccc37b36afbe4f'
        assert m.sha(W / 'tools/fixed_history_logits.py') == 'b3ecd10e5493e608e743c2b14b4e8700efb978d7f8d88b34731453d26878cfd4'
        run('adapter-schema-tests', [str(W / '.lint/venv/bin/python'), '-m', 'unittest',
            'discover', '-s', 'tools', '-p', 'test_fixed_history_capture_receipt.py', '-v'])
        prior_path = B / 'main-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review-root-v1/record.json'
        prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
        assert not prior['active'] and not prior['passed']
        old_test = next(c for c in prior['commands'] if c['label'] == 'existing-logits-tests')
        assert m.closed(old_test) and old_test['session_anchored'] and old_test['exit_code'] == 0
        r['unchanged_comparator_tests_receipt'] = dict(path=str(prior_path), sha256=m.sha(prior_path), tests=11)
        save()
        output = run('all-new-source-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *names])
        assert 'skipped (' not in output
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in r['source_pins'].items())
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True,
                 scope='CPU synthetic receipt rejection/finite-full-row checks and all new-file lints only; no actual production capture')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'scope')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
